2019–2020 | team5 = →[[Windy City Bulls]] | years6 = 2021–2022 | team6 = [[ratiopharm Ulm]] | years7 = 2022–2024 | team7 = [[Fundación CB Granada|Covirán Granada]] | years8 = 2024–present | team8 = [[Sendai 89ers]] | highlights = * [[FIBA Intercontinental Cup]] champion ([[2014 FIBA Intercontinental Cup|2014]]) * [[FIBA Americas League]] champion ([[2014 FIBA Americas League|2014]]) * 3× [[Novo Basquete Brasil|Brazilian League]] champion (2013–2015) * [[Basketball Bundesliga|BBL]] rebounding leader ([[2021–22 Basketball Bundesliga|2022]]) | medaltemplates = {{Medal|Sport|Men's basketball}} {{Medal|Country|{{bk|BRA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA AmeriCup]]}} {{MedalSilver|[[2022 FIBA AmeriCup|2022 Brazil]]|}} {{Medal|Competition|[[FIBA South American Championship]]}} {{Medal|Bronze|[[2014 FIBA South American Championship|2014 Venezuela]]|}} }} '''Cristiano Silva Felício''' (born July 7, 1992) is a Brazilian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Sendai 89ers]] of the [[B.League]]. He previously played in his home country of Brazil for [[Minas Tênis Clube (basketball)|Minas Tênis Clube]] and [[Flamengo Basketball|Flamengo]], in the [[National Basketball Association]] for the [[Chicago Bulls]], and in Germany for [[ratiopharm Ulm]]. ==Professional career== === Minas Tênis Clube (2009–2012) === After playing professionally in Brazil for [[Minas Tênis Clube (basketball)|Minas Tênis Clube]] between 2009 and 2012, Felício moved to [[Sacramento, California]] to attend CCSE Prep Academy in 2012–13 before attempting to gain NCAA eligibility to attend the [[University of Oregon]] in 2013–14.{{cite web|url=http://collegebasketballtalk.nbcsports.com/2013/08/16/report-forward-cristiano-felicio-wont-be-attending-oregon/|title=Report: Forward Cristiano Felicio won't be attending Oregon|work=NBCSports.com|date=August 16, 2013|access-date=July 15, 2015}} === Flamengo (2013–2015) === Felicio was later deemed ineligible to play college basketball and returned to Brazil, where he played a further two seasons for [[Flamengo Basketball|Flamengo]], winning both the 2014 [[2014 FIBA Americas League|FIBA Americas League]] and [[2014 FIBA Intercontinental Cup|FIBA Intercontinental Cup]].{{cite web|url=http://canchallena.lanacion.com.ar/m1/1731118-con-nicolas-laprovittola-como-mvp-flamengo-se-consagro-campeon-intercontinental|title=Con Nicolás Laprovittola como MVP, Flamengo se consagró campeón Intercontinental|work=LaNacion.com|date=September 28, 2014|access-date=October 9, 2015|archive-date=March 3, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303182004/http://canchallena.lanacion.com.ar/m1/1731118-con-nicolas-laprovittola-como-mvp-flamengo-se-consagro-campeon-intercontinental|url-status=dead}} ===Chicago Bulls (2015–2021)=== After joining the [[Chicago Bulls]] for the [[2015 NBA Summer League]], Felício signed with the team on July 12, 2015.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-sign-cristiano-felicio|title=BULLS SIGN CRISTIANO FELICIO|work=NBA.com|date=July 12, 2015|access-date=July 13, 2015}} On December 31, 2015, using the flexible assignment rule, he was assigned to the [[Canton Charge]], the [[NBA Development League|D-League]] affiliate of the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/basketball/bulls/ct-cristiano-felcio-dleague-20151231-story.html|title=Bulls assign Cristiano Felício to D-League|work=ChicagoTribune.com|date=December 31, 2015|access-date=December 31, 2015}} He was recalled by the Bulls on January 13,{{cite web|url=http://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/bulls-cristiano-felicio-recalled-from-nba-d-league/|title=Bulls' Cristiano Felicio: Recalled from NBA D-League|work=CBSSports.com|date=January 13, 2016|access-date=January 13, 2016}} reassigned to Canton on January 15,{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/bulls-assign-felcio-to-d-league/n-5090080|title=Bulls Assign Felício to D-League|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=January 15, 2016|access-date=January 15, 2016}} and recalled again on January 16.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/bulls-recall-felcio-from-canton-charge/n-5090541|title=Bulls Recall Felício from Canton Charge|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=January 16, 2016|access-date=January 16, 2016}} On March 17, he recorded six points and a season-high 10 rebounds in a 118–102 win over the [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web|last=Johnson|first=K.C.|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/basketball/bulls/ct-bulls-rip-nets-report-spt-0318-20160317-story.html|title=Bulls playoff push gets Nets at right time for 118-102 victory|work=ChicagoTribune.com|date=March 17, 2016|access-date=October 30, 2016}} Two days later, he made his first career start, replacing the injured [[Pau Gasol]] in the Bulls' 92–85 win over the [[Utah Jazz]].{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/f/feliccr01/gamelog/2016/|title=Cristiano Felicio 2015-16 Game Log|work=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=March 20, 2016}} On April 9, he had a season-best game in the Bulls' 105–102 win over the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20160409/CLECHI/gameinfo.html|title=Bulls stay in playoff race, beat Cavaliers 105-102|work=NBA.com|date=April 9, 2016|access-date=April 9, 2016}} Felício was 7-for-7 from the field, scored 16 points, grabbed five rebounds, blocked two shots and dished out an assist in 23 minutes.{{cite web|last=Friedell|first=Nick|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/chicago/bulls/post/_/id/23256/cristiano-felicios-performance-makes-front-offices-decision-look-even-worse|title=Cristiano Felicio's performance makes front office's decision look even worse|work=ESPN.com|date=April 9, 2016|access-date=April 9, 2016}} Two days later, he scored 16 points for the second straight game, helping the Bulls defeat the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] 121–116.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20160411/CHINOP/gameinfo.html|title=Jimmy Butler scores 23 points as Bulls beat Pelicans 121-116|work=NBA.com|date=April 11, 2016|access-date=April 11, 2016}} On November 26, 2016, Felício was assigned to Chicago's new D-League affiliate, the [[Windy City Bulls]].{{cite web|url=http://windycity.dleague.nba.com/news/chicago-bulls-assign-three-windy-city/|title=Chicago Bulls Assign Three to Windy City|work=NBA.com|date=November 26, 2016|access-date=December 5, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221154641/http://windycity.dleague.nba.com/news/chicago-bulls-assign-three-windy-city/|archive-date=December 21, 2016|url-status=dead}} He was recalled the next day.{{cite web|url=http://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/bulls-cristiano-felicio-recalled-from-d-league-on-sunday/|title=Bulls' Cristiano Felicio: Recalled from D-League on Sunday|work=CBSSports.com|date=November 27, 2016|access-date=December 5, 2016}} On December 30, 2016, he grabbed a season-high 12 rebounds in a 111–101 loss to the [[Indiana Pacers]]. On January 12, 2017, he scored a season-high 13 points in a 104–89 loss to the [[New York Knicks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/f/feliccr01/gamelog/2017/|title=Cristiano Felicio 2016-17 Game Log|work=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=July 6, 2017}} On July 6, 2017, Felício re-signed with the Bulls.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-re-sign-cristiano-felicio|title=Bulls re-sign Cristiano Felicio|work=NBA.com|date=July 6, 2017|access-date=July 6, 2017}} On March 19, 2018, he scored a career-high 17 points in a 110–92 loss to the [[New York Knicks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400975801|title=Hardaway, Beasley lead Knicks past depleted Bulls, 110-92|work=ESPN.com|date=March 19, 2018|access-date=March 19, 2018}} === ratiopharm Ulm (2021–2022) === On August 9, 2021, Felicio signed with [[ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/ratiopharm-ulm-announces-cristiano-felicio/|title=ratiopharm Ulm announces Cristiano Felicio|last=|first=|date=August 9, 2021|website=|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 9, 2021 |last1=Sportando |first1=Redazione }} === Granada (2022–present) === For the 2022–23 season, Felicio signed with [[Fundación CB Granada|Covirán Granada]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web|url=https://fundacioncbgranada.es/cristiano-felicio-completa-la-plantilla-del-coviran-granada/|title=Cristiano Felicio completa la plantilla del Coviran Granada|publisher=Fundación CB Granada|date=August 26, 2022|accessdate=November 5, 2022}} ==National team career== Felício has been a member of the senior [[Brazilian national basketball team]]. With Brazil, he has played at the following major tournaments: the [[2012 FIBA South American Championship]], the [[2013 FIBA AmeriCup]], the [[2014 FIBA South American Championship]], and the [[Basketball at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2016 Rio Olympics]]. He won the bronze medal at the 2014 FIBA South American Championship.[https://web.archive.org/web/20181123154204/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/Cristiano%20Felicio/pid//_//players.html
